historical_references.reference: Bapon was a famous Bengali poet and philosopher during the medieval period. He was a contemporary of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and is believed to have influenced his thought.

Bapon is also known as Srinath Chakraborty Thakur. He wrote in the Bengali language and is best known for his works 'Bhagavad-vijay' and 'Bhagavat-khanda'. These texts are significant in the development of Bengali devotional literature.
